items.summary: Reject new execution-cockpit implementation this cycle and maintain containment-only execution. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21: 6,219 Amazon clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; 629 clicks and all commission are in aggregate tracking ID other, so site revenue claims are unsupported. September AI spend is $950.44418695 across 5,316 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but it is not period-comparable to one revenue day. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, forecasts, and causal lift are not calculable because matching-period attributed revenue and allocated costs are unavailable. Minimum evidence is a dated ledger matching revenue, AI, infrastructure, and other costs to the same site/content and period, plus a pre-approved learning threshold. Authorize no spend, billing change, money movement, monetization expansion, or new telemetry. Continue only existing period-aligned finance reconciliation and measurement work.
